title: Figure 5.1: Block diagram of the IEC pulsed power system for an inspection station
description: Block diagram captioned 'Figure 5.1. Block Diagram of the IEC Pulsed Power System' showing Prime Power and Controls feeding a High Voltage Supply, Energy Storage, Triggered Spark gap switch and PFN leading to the IEC unit, with a 'Power & safety Control circuits' block. It sits within a section titled 'Pulsed Power for the Inspection Station' discussing test articles (explosives, nuclear materials, drugs) and the capacitor-bank and spark-gap power chain.
